name: Quoridor
subtitle: Run the gauntlet, build the maze
description: A nine-by-nine board, one pawn each, and a fistful of walls. Step forward, back or sideways one square at a time and be the first to reach the far side — or spend a wall instead and make the crossing longer for somebody else. Nobody can ever be sealed in completely, so every wall is a detour, not a cage. Two players with ten walls each, or four with five, against bots, on one device, or online.
controls: Tap a glowing square to step. Switch to walls and drag to a groove to drop one. Arrow keys move, W toggles walls, R rotates, Enter confirms.
